name: Small Clone

dims.source: EHX spec block via data/spec_sheets_staging.json (verified 3.38 x 5.25 x 2.75 in); bare-enclosure back height 2.09 in measured from side photo (references/ehx-small-clone_measurements.md) — 2.75 in is overall including knobs (side-view knob-top 2.63 in corroborates)

enclosure.notes: Single straight slope measured from side views: bare back 2.09 in to bare front 1.32 in over 5.25 in depth. Black lower box; brushed-silver top plate and print supplied by textures/ehx-small-clone-decal.png so sides stay black.

knobs.note: Photo-derived: single RATE hockey-puck knob ~1.05 in dia near back. Ticks are baked into the decal.

led.note: Red STATUS LED right of RATE (front + detail1 views).

footswitch.note: Round chrome stomp centred in purple panel.

depthSwitch.note: DEPTH slide toggle left of RATE. SHARED NEED: parts.js has no toggle/slide-switch builder and assemblePedal ignores this field; hero page renders a page-local toggle until a reusable builder lands.

jacks.note: INPUT back wall, right in top view (detail2 image-left).
OUTPUT back wall, left in top view (detail2 image-right).

powerJack.note: 9V round barrel centred on back wall (detail2).

labels.note: Back edge left, white on black panel.

notes: EHX Small Clone EH 4600 hero. Sloped steel box like Big Muff Pi, scaled to 3.38x5.25. Deck parts seat via surfaceAt() on single sloped deck — no hardcoded y on knobs/LED/switch. Back-wall jacks/power (face:'back'). Top art (black back panel, purple SMALL CLONE panel, front ELECTRO HARMONIX strip, RATE ticks) in decal; remaining words are vector labels. Positions photo-derived, provisional where single-view. SHARED NEED: reusable DEPTH toggle builder in parts.js (spec.depthSwitch currently ignored by assemblePedal; hero page draws it locally).
